description:
We are a passionate and innovation-driven team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, taking on the challenge “Dancing with the SARs.” Our mission is to transform complex Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data from the NASA–ISRO NISAR mission into meaningful, interactive, and easy-to-understand visual insights.

Our vision is simple: Decode the signals from space, visualize Earth's changing rhythm, and turn scientific data into meaningful impact.
